ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERLOCATION_CRM
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
AS(
	SELECT 
     BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
    ,BCA.ADDRESSCATEGORY AS LocationTypeId
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.ADDRESSID)),1) AS LocationId
    ,BCA.START_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCA.END_DATE AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,BCA.PREFERREDADDRESS AS PreferenceId
    ,BCA.HOLDMAILFLAG AS HoldMailIndicator
    ,BCA.HOLDMAILINITIATEDBY AS HoldMailInitiatedById
    ,BCA.HOLDMAILREASON AS HoldMailReason
 	,BCAD.RECORD_STATUS
	,BCA.INSERT_DTTM
	,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	FROM BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS_DELTA BCAD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS BCA ON BCA.ADDRESSID = BCAD.ADDRESSID AND BCA.BANK_ID = BCAD.BANK_ID AND BCA.isLatest = '1' 
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(END_DATE) ENDDTE FROM BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE isLatest = '1' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) ENDDTE ON ENDDTE.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY AND ENDDTE.ENDDTE = BCA.END_DATE --ADDED FOR DUP
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORGKEY,MAX(TMDATE) TMDATE FROM BUSC.CRM_ADDRESS WHERE isLatest = '1' GROUP BY ORGKEY ) TMDATE ON TMDATE.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY AND TMDATE.TMDATE = BCA.TMDATE --ADDED FOR DUP
	WHERE TMDATE.TMDATE IS NOT NULL
	AND ENDDTE.ENDDTE IS NOT NULL


)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId
,HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason
)) HASHROW, LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
 CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId
,HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason
)) HASHROW, LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000'

)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.LocationId,TGT.LocationId) AS LocationId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;


---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[PeriodEndTimestamp] = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LocationId = TGT.LocationId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC ON SRC.LocationId = TGT.LocationId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' ;
 



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerLocation  ( 
[CustomerId]
,[LocationTypeId]
,[LocationId]
,[PeriodStartTimestamp]
,[PeriodEndTimestamp]
,[GlobalLocationNumber]
,[PreferenceId]
,[CustomerLocationNote]
,[HoldMailIndicator]
,[HoldMailInitiatedById]
,[HoldMailReason]
,[SourceCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm])

SELECT 
CustomerId AS CustomerId
,LocationTypeId AS LocationTypeId
,LocationId AS LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,PreferenceId AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS CustomerLocationNote
,HoldMailIndicator AS HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById AS HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason AS HoldMailReason
,'CRM' AS SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;

END
